extraction.Name: Charles Randall, senior
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want his patent to his 640 acre allotment at the time it was issued, for he did not want to pay taxes, but he was informed by the Indian Agency, that he would have to take it, or that he would finally lose it through taxes, for it had been reported to the tax collector, so he accepted it
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: sold his place to Jack Stotts, of Cody, Nebraska, for $5000.00 cash, 25 head of horses, valued at 100.00 apiece, an automobile, valued at $100.00, one bridle and saddle, valued at $130.00, two cows, valued at $50.00 each, two calves, valued at $5.00 each, one elk, valued at $150.00 and one stack of hay, valued at $30.00
extraction.Occupation/Income: farms airship land, of 32 acres, and works for other farmers for his living, this constituting the basis of his income
extraction.NOTES: mentally incompetent, health generally poor; has a wife whose health is poor; has one child to support, the child also having poor health; considers he got a good price for his land; has never received any help from the County, State or United States Government; document dated November 23, 1928 | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Shannon County, South Dakota (tribe not stated)" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')
